pattern.description: Floor-level live-action tracking shot of the actor's feet striding, camera moving with her so the carpet and background smear past while the loafer stays roughly in place.
pattern.why_premium: A low tracking insert on the feet compresses the walk into a purposeful, cinematic beat and builds momentum with motion blur and letterboxing instead of a plain cut.

build_hint.gsap: Not a graphics build: place the clip as a <video> layer on the HyperFrames timeline; if recreating with graphics, tween a background layer with gsap.to(bg, {xPercent:-30, duration:0.6, ease:'none'}) plus a motion-blur filter while the subject layer stays put.
build_hint.remotion: Use <OffthreadVideo> in a <Sequence>; for a synthetic version interpolate background translateX linearly over ~18 frames with no spring, subject fixed.

notes: Camera verdict is pan_left (tracking with the walker); the background element records that apparent motion. b02-b06 are not distinct elements. All three SFX candidates sit outside this burst.
